Preset version 1.0.0, pin `wardrobe_safe@1.0.0#4428181f`, schema version 1. Catalog summary: Identity-safe base with a mandatory wardrobe block; text-to-image only (no source image).

## Purpose

A character with precisely specified clothing, text-to-image only (SPEC 6.1). It requires the wardrobe block to be filled.

File description: Character plus precisely specified clothing. Source-image branch needs the protected-refine node (second queue).

## Status

Status `candidate`. The numeric parameters of this preset are numerically equal to reference (same steps, sampler, scheduler, shift, CFG and SLG). What differs is the input contract and the report; a different result in quality is not claimed.

This preset is numerically equal to reference; the parameter table below shows the same numbers.

## Required inputs

Always: `model`, `positive`, `negative`, `latent`, `seed`. Then:

- `MossPhotonPromptLayout` with the `wardrobe` block filled, its `constraints` output connected to the sampler (empty block: error `missing_required_input`).
- A character LoRA is optional (owner decision OD2).

## Limitations

- A source image or latent is refused (`unsupported_source_input`): the source-based branch needs `MossPhotonProtectedRefine`, which is not in v1.
- Nothing compares the generated clothing with the text: the guard `clothing_attributes` is declared for the second queue and not implemented. A conflicting colour word between the free text and the block is reported as a warning only (`attribute_conflict`).
- `forbidden_changes` is not compiled into the prompt (DV6).
